args.command: echo '=== GUI TOOLS ==='; for x in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable firefox wmctrl xdotool xterm xfce4-terminal gnome-terminal alacritty kitty foot; do p=$(command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$p" ] && echo "$x=$p"; done; echo '=== OPENBOX ==='; command -v openbox || true; command -v openbox-session || true; echo '=== DISPLAY SESSION SCRIPT ==='; sed -n '1,220p' /usr/local/libexec/zen-chatgpt-session.sh 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== CHATGPT UNIT ==='; systemctl show zen-chatgpt-desktop.service -p ExecStart -p User -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== DISPLAY SIZE ==='; runuser -u zenui -- env DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --query 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true
